item.g:title: Homeland Premium Manuka Honey UMF+25, MGO 1200+, 250 g, New Zealand
item.g:description: Manuka honey UMF+25 with MGO 1200+ stands high on the UMF scale, and this 250 g jar comes from Homeland in New Zealand. Asal Al Jebal, 40 years in honey, brings it to Saudi Arabia for collectors of fine honey and for anyone choosing a present that deserves real attention. Product facts UMF+25 grade, matched by an MGO rating of 1200+. Producer Homeland, a New Zealand company registered with UMFHA, the UMF Honey Association. Every step from hive to sealed jar takes place in New Zealand, and every batch is checked separately. Those checks meet the standards of the New Zealand government, the Ministry for Primary Industries (MPI) and UMFHA. Net weight 250 g, roughly 12 large morning spoonfuls. No additives of any kind. Store in a cool, dry cupboard out of direct sunlight, lid firmly closed. Why choose it At UMF+25, this is one of the higher grades on the scale, a natural next step for people who already know Manuka. The producer's standing has been confirmed by the association that grades Manuka in approved laboratories. Asal Al Jebal is Homeland's exclusive authorised agent, so each jar comes to you through the producer's official channel. Ways to enjoy it It pairs nicely with a cup of green or black tea once the tea has cooled slightly, and a thin layer goes a long way on warm bread or plain yogurt. Presented in a gift bag, a UMF+25 jar is a memorable present for a parent, a host or a business contact. FAQ How does UMF+25 compare with UMF+5 or UMF+20? The number is the grade awarded under the UMF system. A higher number means a higher grade, and the matching MGO rating rises with it, here to 1200+. Is an MGO number enough to judge a Manuka jar? Asal Al Jebal advises looking for the UMF mark as well, since MGO on its own is not enough. Is it suitable for infants? Honey should not be given to infants under 12 months.

Asal Al Jebal, 40 years in honey, suggests it for first-time Manuka buyers and for families who want a jar they will reach for every morning. Only honey in the jar, with no additions. A full, slightly herbal Manuka flavour with a smooth, thick texture. Store at room temperature with the lid screwed tight, away from heat and sun. Why choose it An accessible first step into UMF-graded Manuka for daily use. Asal Al Jebal does not sell processed or pasteurised honey, or honey from bees fed on sugar. Product facts Type: Nigella honey (black seed blossom honey), first grade. Origin: Egypt, from black seed farms where the hives are placed. Net weight: 1 kg, around 50 tablespoons of roughly 20 g each. Colour and taste: dark and delicious. Why choose it Made by bees working black seed farms in Egypt, not by stirring black seed into ordinary honey. First-grade honey in a 1 kg jar, a comfortable size for more than a month of daily spoonfuls. Ways to enjoy it Enjoy it by the spoonful like any other honey, stir it into tea or warm milk, or use it to sweeten food. Drizzle it over warm bread with cream cheese, blend it into a date and banana smoothie, or brush it over roasted chicken in the last minutes of cooking. A jar of Egyptian black seed honey also makes a welcome gift for relatives who appreciate traditional flavours. FAQ Is 1 kg of honey the same as 1 litre? Honey is sold by weight, not volume; on the scale this jar weighs 1 kg plus a little. Does it crystallise? Very rarely. Crystallisation is a natural trait of honey and not a sign that it has spoiled. Can my baby try it? Keep all honey away from infants under 12 months.
